title: Rust exposes unauthenticated production RPL mutation APIs
description: RplStack::rpl_node_mut exposes RplNode, RplNode::router_mut exposes Router, and public Router process_dio/process_dio_outcome/process_dio_with_etx variants mutate neighbors/DODAG without AuthenticatedFrame. RplNode handle_frame_rpl variants likewise trust caller bytes/IID. Downstream production code can bypass process_authenticated_dio entirely. Seal raw parsers/mutators as crate-private/test/simulator APIs or require owner-issued evidence in the public production surface; add compile-fail/API tests and end-to-end bypass tests.
